lines.zh: 我的长脖子先穿过树梢
lines.en: My long neck goes through the treetops first

lines.zh: 四只脚一步一步压过去
lines.en: Four feet press forward, step by step

lines.zh: 我走起来像一座会动的山
lines.en: I move like a walking hill
My head rides very high
My tail drags behind

lines.zh: 我每一步都跨过一条小路
lines.en: Each step crosses a small path

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向有光的一边
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the light
My neck sways in the air

lines.zh: 我的长脖子把树顶的叶子扫开了。
lines.en: My long neck sweeps the leaves from the treetops.
I look down below

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落下去，草都压平
lines.en: My foot comes down and the grass flattens

lines.zh: 我慢慢把长脖子往前送
lines.en: I slowly send my long neck forward
I walk slowly, as if measuring the land

lines.zh: 我从一棵树走到下一棵
lines.en: I move from one tree to the next

lines.zh: 我站着，脖子搭在树冠里
lines.en: I stand with my neck laid among the treetops
I slowly chew a leaf
My long neck barely moves

lines.zh: 我要两口水才能咽下去
lines.en: It takes two swallows for me to get it down

lines.zh: 我低头，脖子弯成很长的弧
lines.en: I lower my head, my neck bending a long arc
I hear thunder far off

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重心移到后腿
lines.en: I slowly shift weight to my hind legs
My tail hangs to the ground
I look at the sky past the canopy
I stand quietly

lines.zh: 我把脖子横在一根枝上
lines.en: I lay my neck across a branch

lines.zh: 我在很高的地方嚼叶子
lines.en: I chew leaves high up

lines.zh: 我的头低下去又抬起来
lines.en: My head dips and rises again

lines.zh: 我一动不动地站了很久
lines.en: I stand without moving for a long while
You only reach my ankle

lines.zh: 你抬头看很久也看不完整
lines.en: Look up as long as you like, you cannot see all of me

lines.zh: 我的脖子比你整个人还长
lines.en: My neck is longer than your whole body
I have no need to fear you

lines.zh: 你站在我影子里很凉快吧
lines.en: You are cool in my shadow, are you not
I have to lower my head to see you
Don't stand by my feet; my neck is long.
One step carries me over you

lines.zh: 你身上没有我熟悉的味道
lines.en: You carry no scent I know
I lower my head slowly
You have walked below for a long time
Your neck will ache if you look up too long
I was struck, very lightly
This hide of mine is thick
I look down at that small thing
My step lost half a beat
I slowly take one step back
I can take much more
My tail swung once
I raise my head, unwilling to bother
I walk on
Such a small amount
Even held up, I can hardly see it
I eat a whole tree in a day

lines.zh: 那点东西我舌头都够不到
lines.en: That would not touch my tongue

lines.zh: 我够得到，但我会踩到你
lines.en: I can reach it, but I would step on you
Stand farther off first
My head comes down very slowly

lines.zh: 这一点在舌尖都没味道
lines.en: This would not even taste on my tongue
I prefer the ones in the canopy

lines.zh: 你撞在我前腿上，像撞一根石柱。
lines.en: You struck my foreleg as if against a stone pillar.
My step paused
I look down to see what it was
Stepping back will do
That was like wind to me
I blocked with my tail
I carefully step around you
We rarely bump into things
I bear you no ill will
My kind move very slowly
Such things take a long time

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在很远的林子里
lines.en: My mate is in a distant wood
We keep in touch by calling
This is not the right time to ask
I raised my head back up
I go back to eating leaves
In a lifetime we do not travel far

lines.zh: 长脖子绕过来，先碰碰你的脖子。
lines.en: My neck curves around to touch yours first.
I attend to my own business
My long tongue curls it up
I bring it in with my tongue

lines.zh: 地上没有值得吃的东西
lines.en: There is nothing on the ground worth eating
I chew it once
This has no taste at all
I spit it aside

lines.zh: 我的舌头比你的手臂长
lines.en: My tongue is longer than your arm
I picked at it for a long while
I gave up in the end
Lowering my head takes a long time

lines.zh: 我的长脖子是最好的瞭望台
lines.en: My long neck is the best lookout
I recall that direction
I slowly turn my body
My feet are ready
This thing is too small for me
I only need to set a foot down
There is movement in that tree
I stretch my neck that way
My shadow covers it first

lines.zh: 这个东西太小，我几乎看不见
lines.en: This thing is so small I can barely see it
I slowly shift my forefoot
I look down at it
It runs much too fast
My neck follows it around
I shift one step at a time
It has circled to my hind legs
I am not made for chasing
It is under my feet, I dare not move
I let it wander off
Just a little while longer

lines.zh: 我一直看着脚下那一点
lines.en: I keep watching that spot below
It moves a step, I move half

lines.zh: 我的长脖子在它头顶投下影
lines.en: My long neck casts shade over its head

lines.zh: 我等它走出我的落脚范围
lines.en: I wait for it to leave my stepping range
I lift my foot and set it down again
I set my forefoot down
I push it away with my neck
I held back with this one
I bump once and stop

lines.zh: 我的脚掌压出了一片坑
lines.en: My foot pressed out a patch of pits
I only wanted it to go

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来挡住路
lines.en: I turn my body to block the path
My foot presses down slowly
I swing my long neck

lines.zh: 我的尾巴从侧面扫过来
lines.en: My tail sweeps in from the side
I used only a little of it

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了一步就停
lines.en: I step aside once and stop
I do not want to tread on it
I walk out from behind the treeline

lines.zh: 我的头先出现在树冠上
lines.en: My head appears above the canopy first

lines.zh: 中国的化石把我带到这
lines.en: Fossils from China brought me here

lines.zh: 我的脖子几乎占了半个身子
lines.en: My neck is nearly half my body
The ground shivers at my steps
The trees here are too short

lines.zh: 我低下头去找最高的那棵
lines.en: I lower my head to find the tallest one
I walk slowly into the sunlight

lines.zh: 我从很高的地方先把头放下来
lines.en: I lower my head down first from high up

lines.zh: 我的四条腿落地，地面下沉一点
lines.en: My four legs land and the ground sinks a little

lines.zh: 我在这里能吃到别人吃不到的叶
lines.en: Here I can reach leaves no one else can

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸直，看得很远
lines.en: I stretch my neck straight and see very far

lines.zh: 我的体型让四周安静下来
lines.en: My size quiets everything around
I slowly lie down

lines.zh: 我的脚步把这地方变得很小
lines.en: My steps make this place feel small

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，又慢慢放下
lines.en: I lift a leg and set it down slowly

lines.zh: 我第一次尝到这片叶子的味道
lines.en: I taste the leaves here for the first time
Fire on me is like burning grass

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，压塌了一片树
lines.en: I slid down a slope and flattened trees

lines.zh: 爆炸在我脚下炸开，我晃了一下
lines.en: The blast went off at my feet and I swayed once

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的腿上，像根刺
lines.en: An arrow in my leg, like a thorn

lines.zh: 那股术力顺着我的脖子爬
lines.en: That magic crawled along my neck

lines.zh: 这附近的树冠都吃光了
lines.en: The canopy here is stripped bare
Lightning struck my neck
The ground beneath vanished all at once
